Name: SlimeTamer
Author: ChickenCoder
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Slime Tamer lets you tame wild slimes and turn them into loyal companions. Craft a special collar, find a slime in the mines, and make it your friend. Your tamed slime will follow you, attack hostile monsters, and use elemental powers in battle!

Each slime has a unique element based on its color — fire, ice, or poison. Fire slimes burn enemies, ice slimes slow them down, and poison slimes deal damage over time.
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io)
2. Download and extract the ZIP into Stardew Valley/Mods/
3. Launch the game via SMAPI
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Craft a Slime Collar (Combat Level 2)
- Tame wild Green Slimes with a right-click
- Tamed slimes follow you anywhere
- They automatically attack hostile monsters
- Elemental effects: Fire (burn), Ice (slow), Poison (damage over time)
- Configurable max slimes (1-5) via GMCM
- Custom sprite for the collar
- Saves between game sessions

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for settings)
